name: Hobart
aboutDesc: Brought to you by the City of Hobart, Hello Hobart showcases the people, places, and businesses that make the city unique. From local retailers and cafes to restaurants and lifestyle spots, it highlights the stories behind them while encouraging residents and visitors to explore and support Hobart’s vibrant local scene.
